Package frc.robot.subsystems.arm

Class AbstractArmSubsystem

java.lang.Object
edu.wpi.first.wpilibj2.command.SubsystemBase
frc.robot.subsystems.arm.AbstractArmSubsystem
All Implemented Interfaces:
edu.wpi.first.util.sendable.Sendable, edu.wpi.first.wpilibj2.command.Subsystem, AutoCloseable
Direct Known Subclasses:
ArmSubsystem, SimArmSubsystem
public abstract class AbstractArmSubsystem extends edu.wpi.first.wpilibj2.command.SubsystemBase implements AutoCloseable
Shared position-control implementation for real and simulated arms.

The supplied PID controller, feedforward, motor controller, and encoder define the mechanism. This class owns target clamping, periodic control, limit checks, and dashboard telemetry.
